objective: Remediate approved active-template UX/security evidence gaps without adding JavaScript or changing ranking/cache contracts.
scope: Link the existing stylesheet into active app templates when safe
Cover active template structure and no-script policy
Run focused local Markdown/fragment/link checks where feasible
Attempt available browser, keyboard, and offline evidence
Record evidence and limitations in the approved decision note
acceptance: Focused tests pass, including positive, negative, and edge cases
Diff check passes and scope is inspected
Focused commit is created and approved-scope worktree is clean
constraints: No JavaScript, dynamic widgets, KaTeX, documentation narrative edits, ranking changes, or cache changes
Stop on CSP conflict, accessibility failure, unrelated failure, unavailable required evidence, or scope expansion

evidence.focused_tests: python -m pytest tests/test_active_template_ui.py tests/test_local_document_links.py tests/test_app_workflow.py tests/test_security_headers.py tests/test_docs_routes.py -q: 223 passed in 2.22s
evidence.compile_and_diff: python -m compileall -q app electre3 tests && git diff --check: exit 0
evidence.browser_tool_attempt: No Playwright, Chromium, Chrome, or Firefox executable found; browser, keyboard/AT, and network-disabled checks unavailable.

fallback: Preserve verified evidence and stop with a documented limitation if required tooling or evidence is unavailable.
last_action: Focused commit created and clean-tree verification passed.
